skills.name: Swordsmanship
skills.desc: A skill that increases your accuracy. The skill becomes more effective as you train.

skills.name: Potion Mastery
skills.desc: You become adept at using recovery items. You may recover more depending upon the level of your training.

skills.name: Slaying
skills.desc: A skill that increases your accuracy and damage. The skill becomes more effective as you train.

skills.name: Thrusting
skills.desc: Attack enemies outside of the melee range using the energy of your weapon. The damage done increases with training.

skills.name: Half Moon
skills.desc: An ancient skill attack that hits 4 nearby enemies with the power of wind created from the swing of a weapon. Its damage increases with training.

skills.name: Shoulder Dash
skills.desc: A shoulder blow to push away enemies of lower levels. As you train harder, you'll be able to push more enemies.

skills.name: Flaming Sword
skills.desc: Transfer your body's energy onto the weapon to increase its damage.  The damage bonus increases with training.

skills.name: Dragon Rise
skills.desc: Harness the body's energy to throw yourself into the enemies. Its damage increases with training.

skills.name: Blade Storm
skills.desc: A fast attack that deals 2 blows to the enemy. Its damage increases with training.

skills.name: Destructive Surge
skills.desc: Transfers your body's energy onto your weapon to deal damage to your enemies around you. Its damage increases with training.

skills.name: Advanced Potion Mastery
skills.desc: You become further adept at using recovery items. You may recover more depending upon the level of your training. Works with Regular Potion Mastery.

skills.name: Interchange
skills.desc: A skill that allows you to switch the location of you and your target. Its chance of success increases with training.

skills.name: Defiance
skills.desc: Significantly increase your defense and magic resistance whilst reducing attack power. Duration increases with training.

skills.name: Beckon
skills.desc: A skill that pulls a distant target into melee range. Its success rate increases with training.

skills.name: Might
skills.desc: Moderately increase your damage. The damage bonus and duration increases with training.

skills.name: Swift Blade
skills.desc: A skill that deals damage to enemies by releasing the energy within your weapon as you thrust it into the ground.

skills.name: Assault
skills.desc: Enemies affected by shoulder dash becomes unconscious.

skills.name: Endurance
skills.desc: Uses your body's energy to avoid being poisoned, pushed back from enemy attacks, and any other harmful status effects.

skills.name: Reflect Damage
skills.desc: Returns a percentage of damage done to you back to the attacker.

skills.name: Fetter
skills.desc: You slow your enemy's movement speed and attack speed using your body's energy.

skills.name: Mass Beckon
skills.desc: When successful all enemies around the caster are pulled to the perimeter of the caster. Success increases with training.

skills.name: Invincibility
skills.desc: Ignores all attacks except internal attacks for a certain period of time. The duration increases with training.

skills.name: Defensive Mastery
skills.desc: Increases the probability of using your maximum defensive capabilities. Probability increases with training.

skills.name: Advanced Defiance
skills.desc: Improves Defiance by removing the need to reduce attack power. Duration increases even further with training.

skills.name: Physical Immunity
skills.desc: Permanently reduce all incoming physical attacks. Reduction amount increases with training.

skills.name: Magic Immunity
skills.desc: Permanently reduce all incoming magic attacks. Reduction amount increases with training.

skills.name: Advanced Reflect Damage
skills.desc: Improves Reflect Damage by increasing reflect damage percentage and duration even further with training.

skills.name: Seismic Slam
skills.desc: Attacks an area with deadly force that has the potential to knock out enemies for a period of time.

skills.name: Advanced Destructive Surge
skills.desc: Provides a wider area of attack for Destructive Surge at level 3 or above, and increases overall power. Damage dealt increases with training.

skills.name: Defensive Blow
skills.desc: Use the full force of your swing to temporarily decrease your targets defensive abilities. Defensives reduces increases with training.

skills.name: Crushing Wave
skills.desc: Sends a powerful energy through your weapon which cuts down enemies from a distance. Damage increases with training.

skills.name: Elemental Swords
skills.desc: Throws a sword at the target inflicting damage. If the target is killed there is a chance to regain a percentage of your drained mana. Amount of swords thrown, damage dealt and mana regained increases with training.

skills.name: Fire Ball
skills.desc: The most basic Fire spell. Its damage increases with training.

skills.name: Lightning Ball
skills.desc: The most basic Lightning spell. Its damage increases with training.

skills.name: Ice Bolt
skills.desc: The most basic Ice spell that damages the enemy and slows its movement speed. Its damage increases with training.

skills.name: Gust Blast
skills.desc: The most basic Wind spell that pushes away enemies. Its damage and chance to push away your enemy increases with training.

skills.name: Repulsion
skills.desc: A defensive spell that allows you to push away enemies of lower level. This spell has a fixed chance for success. The range of the spell and chance of success increase with training.

skills.name: Electric Shock
skills.desc: A spell that knocks the enemy unconscious.  Your chance of success and duration of its effect increases with training.

old.tag_note: 语义推测：Zircon Electric Shock 为闪电麻痹

skills.name: Teleportation
skills.desc: A spell that moves you to a random location. Your chance of success increases with training.

skills.name: Adamantine Fire Ball
skills.desc: A spell that is more powerful than the Fireball. Its damage increases with training.

skills.name: Fire Bounce
skills.desc: Bounces a powerful fireball between close targets. The number of bounces increase with training.

skills.name: Thunder Bolt
skills.desc: A spell that creates Thunderbolts to strike down on your enemies. Its damage increases with training.

skills.name: Ice Blades
skills.desc: A spell that is more powerful than the Iceball. Its damage increases with training.

skills.name: Cyclone
skills.desc: A Cyclone attack spell that damages a single enemy. Its damage increases with training.

skills.name: Scorched Earth
skills.desc: A spell that shoots out line of fire along the ground, damaging all enemies caught within the fire. Its damage increases with training.

skills.name: Lightning Beam
skills.desc: A spell that shoots out a beam of lightning, damaging all enemies caught within the lightning. Its damage increases with training.

skills.name: Frozen Earth
skills.desc: A spell that erects shards of ice from the ground in a line, damaging all enemies in the path. Its damage increases with training.

skills.name: Blow Earth
skills.desc: A spell that allows you to harness the power of the winds and cause it to blow in front of the caster in a straight line. Its damage increases with training.

skills.name: Fire Wall
skills.desc: A spell that creates a wall of fire in the shape of a cross damaging enemies over a period of time. Its damage increases with training.

skills.name: Expel Undead
skills.desc: A spell that instantly kills undead enemies. Its chance of success increases with training.

old.tag_note: 语义推测：Zircon Expel Undead 为驱散不死

skills.name: Geo Manipulation
skills.desc: A spell that harnesses the body's energy to move to a desired location. The chance of success increases with training.

old.tag_note: 语义推测：Zircon Geo Manipulation 为空间系

skills.name: Magic Shield
skills.desc: Creates a magical shield around the caster that reduces the damage taken for a set period of time. The duration of the spell increases with training.

skills.name: Fire Storm
skills.desc: A spell that deals fire damage to all enemies within a fixed area(3x3) of choice. Its damage increases with training.

skills.name: Lightning Wave
skills.desc: A spell that deals lightning damage to all enemies within a fixed area(3x3) of choice. Its damage increases with training.

skills.name: Ice Storm
skills.desc: A spell that deals ice damage to all enemies within a fixed area(3x3) of choice with ice. Its damage increases with training.

skills.name: Dragon Tornado
skills.desc: A spell that attacks all enemies within a fixed area(3x3) of choice with a cyclone. Its damage increases with training.

skills.name: Greater Frozen Earth
skills.desc: A spell that erects 3 lines of ice shards from the ground in three directions to damage and slow the enemies. Its damage increases with training.

skills.name: Chain Lightning
skills.desc: A spell that inflicts lightning damage to enemies in a large area(9x9), but the damage inflicted decreases as the lightning spreads out from its attack point. Its damage increases with training.

skills.name: Meteor Shower
skills.desc: A spell that damages enemies within a set range. Its damage and the number of enemies affected increases with training.

skills.name: Renounce
skills.desc: A spell that sacrifices your HP to increase your Spell Power for a fixed period of time.  The Spell Power bonus increases with training.

skills.name: Tempest
skills.desc: A spell that creates a Cyclone to attack enemies in a set area(3x3) for a set period of time. Its damage and duration increases with training.

skills.name: Judgement Of Heaven
skills.desc: The enemy that attacks you gets struck by lightning each time you take damage.

skills.name: Thunder Storm
skills.desc: When cast, lightning strikes down randomly in a fixed area, dealing massive damage.

skills.name: Mirror Image
skills.desc: The spell creates an illusion of yourself which has the same magic attack abilities. You must have a dark ore to cast this spell.

skills.name: Frost Bite
skills.desc: Protect yourself with frost magic that stores up received damage over time and then expells it in a wide radius to damage and slow the enemy. Damage stored, chance to store and duration all increase with training.

skills.name: Superior Magic Shield
skills.desc: Creates a barrier around the caster that blocks all damage taken until depleted. The amount of damage absorbed increases with training.

skills.name: Burning
skills.desc: Ignites the enemy and inflicts a continuous fire attack for a certain period of time. Passively applies to all fire skills. Damage and duration increase with training.

skills.name: Asteroid
skills.desc: Summons fire from the sky to inflict massive area damage, leaving fire walls in its wake. Damage increases with training.

skills.name: Ice Rain
skills.desc: A spell that rains down with ice shards, repeatedly damaging anyone inside with a chance to freeze them. Duration increases with training.

skills.name: Elemental Hurricane
skills.desc: You condense your body's energy and burst it in a line, dealing damage to anyone caught in its path. The energy does not have any properties unless used with a dark stone.

skills.name: Shock
skills.desc: Put the enemy in a state of temporary shock for a certain period of time. Passively applies to all lightning skills. Success and duration increases with training.

skills.name: Storm
skills.desc: Creates a massive area storm that continously damages anything in its radius. Damage increases with training.

skills.name: Lightning Strike
skills.desc: A spell that bounces a powerful elecric shock between close targets, getting stronger each hit. Number of bounces and power multiplier increases with training.

skills.name: Tornado
skills.desc: Summon a tornado which damages anything in its path. The effects of the tornado increase with training.

skills.name: Heal
skills.desc: A spell to heal yourself or others by using your body's energy. The amount healed increases with training.

skills.name: Spirit Sword
skills.desc: A skill that increases your Accuracy. The Accuracy bonus increases with training.

old.tag_note: 老版归战技系，Zircon 归道士 Spirit Sword

skills.name: Poison Dust
skills.desc: A spell that decreases your enemy's defense or strength, depending on the Poison Powder, for a set period of time. The effect's duration increases with training.

skills.name: Explosive Talisman
skills.desc: Throws an explosive talisman at the enemy. Its power is increased when used with a Dark Talisman.  Its damage increases with training.

skills.name: Evil Slayer
skills.desc: Harness the holy energy in your hands to throw at your enemy. Its power is increased when used with a Holy Talisman. Its damage increases with training.

skills.name: Empowered Explosive Talisman
skills.desc: Augments Explosive Talisman (and Improved), When casting Explosive Talisman there is a chance it will effect nearby enemies.

skills.name: Empowered Evil Slayer
skills.desc: Augments Evil Slayer (and Greater), When casting Evil Slayer there is a chance it will effect nearby enemies.

skills.name: Summon Skeleton
skills.desc: By inserting your body's energy into the talisman, you summon a powerful spirit to fight for you. The strength of your summoned spirit increases with training.

skills.name: Invisibility
skills.desc: Temporarily hide yourself, vanishing from your enemy's sight.  Its duration increases with training.

skills.name: Magic Resistance
skills.desc: Using your body's energy, you increase your resistance to magic. The resistance bonus and duration of the effect increases with training.

skills.name: Mass Invisibility
skills.desc: An advanced invisibility technique that allows you to hide everyone in a fixed area(3x3). Its duration increases with training.

skills.name: Greater Evil Slayer
skills.desc: A spell that is more powerful than the Holy Strike. Its damage increases with training, and even more so if used with a Holy Talisman.

skills.name: Resilience
skills.desc: Using your body's energy, you increase your defense against physical attacks. Its duration and defense bonus increases with training.

skills.name: Trap Octagon
skills.desc: A spell that uses a talisman to trap enemies in a small area. Its duration increases with training.

skills.name: Combat Kick
skills.desc: Kick your enemies away from you. Its damage and chance to push back your enemies increases with training.

old.tag_note: 跨职业重归类：Zircon 归道士系 Combat Kick

skills.name: Elemental Superiority
skills.desc: Use a talisman to increase the spell power of yourself or others, or use the elemental talisman to increase the attack elements.  Its duration increases with training.

skills.name: Summon Shinsu
skills.desc: By focusing your body's energy onto a talisman, you call upon the Holy Beasts to fight for you. The strength of the Holy Beast increases with training.

skills.name: Mass Heal
skills.desc: A spell that heals multiple people within a fixed area(5x5) tiles at the same time. The amount healed increases with training.

skills.name: Summon Jin Skeleton
skills.desc: By focusing your body's energy onto a talisman, you summon a mighty spirit to fight for you. You may use this Mu-Gong even if you have already summoned a Holy Beast or a Skeleton. The strength of the mighty spirit increases with training.

skills.name: Blood Lust
skills.desc: Use your body's energy to increase the attack of yourself or others. Its duration and damage bonus increases with training.

skills.name: Resurrection
skills.desc: Revive the dead by using a Talisman of Soul. The chance to revive increases with training.

skills.name: Purification
skills.desc: Removes all magical and skill effects. Not only does it remove poison and paralysis, but any ability enhancement effects also.

skills.name: Strength Of Faith
skills.desc: Increases the damage of your summoned creature by sacrificing your own damage. The damage bonus of your summoned creature increases with training.

skills.name: Transparency
skills.desc: You become invisible to monsters and other players. Its duration increases with training.

skills.name: Celestial Light
skills.desc: Draws upon your remaining bit of energy to block an enemy attack that would otherwise kill you. Also restores a small amount of HP.

skills.name: Empowered Healing
skills.desc: Increases the amount healed by your next healing spell. The bonus amount healed depends on your level and training.

skills.name: Life Steal
skills.desc: Use your body's energy to increase the Life stealing of yourself or others. Its duration and Life steal bonus increases with training.

skills.name: Demonic Recovery
skills.desc: Passively increases the health of all summoned creatures, and actively restores the health of any summoned demonic creature. Health restored increases with training.

skills.name: Improved Explosive Talisman
skills.desc: An upgraded version of the Explosive Talisman, used to throw 3 explosive talismans to deal massive amounts of damage. Its damage increases if used with Dark Talisman.

skills.name: Empowered Poison Dust
skills.desc: Augment's Poison dust, When casting poison dust there is a chance it will effect nearby enemies.

skills.name: Summon Demonic Creature
skills.desc: By inserting your body's energy into the talisman, you summon a infernal creature to fight for you. The power of your summoned creature increases with training.

skills.name: Cursed Doll
skills.desc: Create a dummy that resembles your target by cursing them with a Talisman of Soul. Damage done to this dummy will damage your enemy instead. Duration of curse increases with training.

skills.name: Demon Explosion
skills.desc: Cause your summoned creature to explode, inflicting damage to nearby enemies. damage inflicted depends on the level of your summoned creature.

skills.name: Thunder Kick
skills.desc: When you kick an enemy, your target enemy remains in place, but the surrounding enemies gets pushed back or receives a large amount of damage.

skills.name: Empowered Purification
skills.desc: Augments Purification, When casting Purification, there is a chance it will effect nearby targets.

skills.name: Parasite
skills.desc: Attaches a dark parasite to the target which slowly drains their health, then eventually explodes and damages surrounding enemies. Duration of parasite increases with training.

skills.name: Infection
skills.desc: When a monster is infected with a parasite, the parasite and all other poisons will now spread to all nearby monsters. Transferred damage of infection increases with training.

skills.name: Empowered Resurrection
skills.desc: Augments Resurrection, When casting Resurrection, there is a chance it will effect nearby Allies.

skills.name: Spiritualism
skills.desc: Using the energy of your talisman you increase your elemental defense strength. Its duration and ability increases with training.

skills.name: Neutralize
skills.desc: Lowers the targets attack power, movement and attack speed. When incapacited they will not be able to recover health. Duration of effect increases with training.

skills.name: Empowered Neutralize
skills.desc: Augments Neutralize, When casting Neutralize it will now affect nearby targets. Amount of targets affected increases with training.

skills.name: Empowered Celestial Light
skills.desc: Provides further HP regain to Celestial Light at level 3 or above, and acts as a shield giving the caster a small offensive and defensive bonus. Amount increases with training.

skills.name: Searing Light
skills.desc: Deals a certain amount of soul damage, and depending on the target also temporarily prevents attack or movement. Damage dealt and effect duration increases with training.

skills.name: Soul Resonance
skills.desc: Resonates your soul with the target to increase both of your healths. If either of you die the other does too. Only available when in a group.

skills.name: Corpse Exploder
skills.desc: Throw a talisman at a dead target to explode their body and damage the surrounding area.

skills.name: Dark Soul Prison
skills.desc: Cast a 7x7 spell of darkness that instills pain and fear in the enemy, continously damaging anyone in its radius. Duration and damage increases with training.

skills.name: Summon Dead
skills.desc: Reawake a corpse and command the dead. Requires a soul amulet.

skills.name: _Blank_
skills.desc: UNUSED

skills.name: Willow Dance
skills.desc: Increases your Agility. Your Agility bonus increases with training.

skills.name: Vine Tree Dance
skills.desc: Increases your Accuracy. Your accuracy bonus increases with training.

skills.name: Discipline
skills.desc: Increases your accuracy and minimum damage. Accuracy and minimum damage bonus increases with training.

skills.name: Bloody Flower
skills.desc: Increases your Life Stealing. Its effects increases with training.

skills.name: Poisonous Cloud
skills.desc: Creates a cloud of poison around you, increasing your dodge rate while standing in the clouds.

skills.name: Full Bloom
skills.desc: Converts a percentage of your max mana into additional physical damage.

skills.name: Cloak
skills.desc: You become invisible. While in this state, you can move, attack, and use items at the expense of your HP.  You become visible when you attack or use an item. The amount of HP used decreases with training.

skills.name: White Lotus
skills.desc: Converts a percentage of your max mana into additional physical damage. Enemies damaged by Full Bloom receives additional damage.

skills.name: Calamity Of Full Moon
skills.desc: You have chance to deal additional damage when attacking monsters out of cloak. Its chance and damage bonus increases with training.

skills.name: Wraith Grip
skills.desc: Summons a creature of darkness that prevents the enemies from moving and steals mana for a set period of time. Its duration increases with training.

skills.name: Red Lotus
skills.desc: Converts a percentage of your max mana into additional physical damage. Enemies damaged by White Lotus receives additional damage.

skills.name: Hell Fire
skills.desc: Summons a demon from the Flames of Fire and Brimstone to inflict fire damage to an opponent and additional fire damage over time. Its damage increases with time.

skills.name: Pledge Of Blood
skills.desc: When cloaking, your HP consumption is reduced by a fixed percentage depending on the level of your training.

skills.name: Rake
skills.desc: Your attacks made while in a cloaking state reduces your enemy's movement speed by 50%. This ability brings you out of the cloaking state. Its effect and duration increases with training.

skills.name: Sweetbrier
skills.desc: Converts a percentage of your max mana into additional physical damage. Enemies damaged by Red Lotus receives additional damage.

skills.name: Summon Puppet
skills.desc: Trick your enemies to believe you're dead while you summon a puppet and become invisible. The summoned puppet deals fire damage when attacked. This can be used while in combat and number of puppets summoned increases with training.

skills.name: Karma
skills.desc: While in an invisible state, you deal massive damage to your enemy by spending a percentage of your total HP. You cannot use a recovery item for 10 seconds after the attack.

skills.name: Touch Of The Departed
skills.desc: Your opponent becomes dominated by the Wraith Grip spell effect and is unable to use any Mu-Gong. You also receive a percentage of your target's Mana. The amount of Mana received increases with training.

skills.name: Waning Moon
skills.desc: You have chance to deal additional damage when attacking monsters cloaked. Its chance and damage bonus increases with training.

skills.name: Ghost Walk
skills.desc: When Cloaking, you have a chance to increase your movement speed by 100%. This chance increases with training.

skills.name: Elemental Puppet
skills.desc: The effect of your puppet summoned by the Summon Puppet spell changes depending on your equipped dark stone. The charges of the dark stone decreases when you use the Summon Puppet spell with the dark stone equipped.  The effect of your puppet increases with training.

skills.name: Rejuvenation
skills.desc: Your HP and Mana regeneration rate increases while not in combat. The regeneration rate bonus increases with training.

skills.name: Resolution
skills.desc: Increases the accuracy of Karma and allows it to ignore your opponent's defense by a set amount. Accuracy and defense ignored increases with training.

skills.name: Change Of Seasons
skills.desc: Removed from game

skills.name: Release
skills.desc: When performing Karma, your HP consumption is reduced by a set percentage, depending on your level of training.

skills.name: Flame Splash
skills.desc: Deals physical damage as fire damage to 4 enemies around you. The effect is triggered by chance when you deal damage to an enemy. Amount of damage dealt increases with training.

skills.name: The New Beginning
skills.desc: When activated, your next Flash of Light used within 60 seconds deals multiple attacks as additional magic damage. Its damage increases with training.

skills.name: Dance Of Swallow
skills.desc: Damage your opponent after you teleport and also has a chance to stun your opponent. Its chance to stun increases with training.

skills.name: Dark Conversion
skills.desc: While active, a set percentage of your maximum Mana is converted to your HP, providing HP equal to 2 times the Mana used.  Its effect increases with training.

skills.name: Dragon Repulse
skills.desc: Inflicts physical damage and pushes nearby enemies back. The push back effect does not work on enemies 8 levels higher than you. Damage dealt increases with training.

skills.name: Advent Of Demon
skills.desc: Increases your Max AC. Its effects increases with training.

skills.name: Advent Of Devil
skills.desc: Increases your Max MR. Its effects increases with training.

skills.name: Abyss
skills.desc: You shroud your opponent in darkness, reducing their sight and accuracy by a set percentage. The duration increases with training.

skills.name: Flash Of Light
skills.desc: You deal massive damage to all enemies within 2 tiles.

skills.name: Stealth
skills.desc: When you perform an action that causes you to break cloak, you're able prevent it by spending the charged “The New Beginning”. Cannot be used without the The New Beginning effect. The chance of remaining in the cloaking state increases with training.

skills.name: Evasion
skills.desc: You have a chance to dodge your opponent's Elemental attack. Its chance increases with training.

skills.name: Raging Wind
skills.desc: Your Minimum defense increases by a percentage of your Maximum defense , and your Maximum defense is decreased by a set percentage. Its effects increases with training.

skills.name: Dragon Blood
skills.desc: Poisons targets hit by your swing, dealing a percentage of damage every 2 seconds for 10 seconds. Stacks up to 4 times. Chance to poison and damage dealt increases with training. Requires Poison Bottle.

skills.name: Fatal Blow
skills.desc: Gain increased attack power when your targets health falls below 30%. Damage dealt increases with training.

skills.name: Massacre
skills.desc: Upon killing an enemy a percentage of the remaining damage dealt is passed to all nearby targets. Damage dealt increases with training.

skills.name: Last Stand
skills.desc: Increases your physical resistance when your health falls below 30%. Resistance amount and probability to activate increases with training.

skills.name: Magic Combustion
skills.desc: Throw a spear which burns away your targets mana. Applies only in PvP. Mana removed increases with training.

skills.name: Vitality
skills.desc: Increases your recovery rate when your health falls below 30%. Applies to all forms of recovery. Rate of recovery increases with training.

skills.name: Art of Shadows
skills.desc: Increases the amount of puppets summoned, and the area in which they appear. Amount summed increases with training.

skills.name: Chain
skills.desc: Chains your target to all nearby targets, preventing them from moving far apart from each other. Amount of targets which can be chained together and duration of chain increases with training.

skills.name: Concentration
skills.desc: Increases your crit chance for a period of time. Rate and duration increases with training.

skills.name: Dual Weapon Skills
skills.desc: Permanently increases the attack power of all dual weapon attacks. Power increases with training.

skills.name: Containment
skills.desc: Prevents targets in a large radius of the caster from moving for 3 seconds whilst dealing continuous damage. Number of targets affected increases with training.

skills.name: Dragon Wave
skills.desc: Reduces the cost of Flame Splash. At level 3 or above it increases the amount of targets hit. Cost reduces further with training.

skills.name: Hemorrhage
skills.desc: Continuously damages the enemy and prevents any health recovery. Damage and duration increases with training.

skills.name: Burning Fire
skills.desc: Create a trap on the floor from the fires of Hell. Lasts for 15 seconds and when stepped on deals damage in a 3x3 area. Damage dealt and amount of traps which can be placed increases with training.

skills.name: Chain Of Fire
skills.desc: All chained targets are slowed. At level 1 or above damage done to the leader will be dealt to all targets they're chained to. At level 2 or above continuous fire damage will be dealt to all targets. At level 3 or above will inflict damage in a 3x3 radius when the leader dies.

quests.name: Are they in Banya Yeti?
quests.desc: ：Hello [PLAYERNAME], Those pesky Forest Yeti have made a nuisance of themselves around Banya Village, Could you go kill a few so we can open our trade routes again.

quests.name: Are they in Bichon Yeti?
quests.desc: ：Hello [PLAYERNAME], Those pesky Forest Yeti have made a nuisance of themselves around Bichon Town, Could you go kill a few so we can open our trade routes again.

quests.name: Are they in Lost Paradise Yeti?
quests.desc: ：Hello [PLAYERNAME], Those pesky Forest Yeti have made a nuisance of themselves around Lost Paradise, Could you go kill a few so we can open our trade routes again.
quests.zh: Are they in Lost Paradise Yeti?

quests.name: Crushing the Remains Pt. 1
quests.desc: ：Good day to you [PLAYERNAME], It seems a slight problem has arisen, namely in the form of Skeletons that have taken over a number of caves. How about you deal with those for me and bring me back some spines to prove it?
quests.goals: ：收集 Skeletons ×50 （Skeleton 1/2、Skeleton Axe Thrower 1/2、Skeleton Warrior 1/2、Skeleton Axeman 1/2）

quests.name: Crushing the Remains Pt. 2
quests.desc: ：It seems something more sinister is at hand, Those skeletons seemed to be receiving instructions from elsewhere, Maybe you should check that out?

quests.name: Curing the Poison Pt. 1
quests.desc: ：Hello [PLAYERNAME], A number of our soldiers have been poisoned by spiders, could you help me gather the ingredients for an antidote?. The Spitting Spiders located around town should provide you with the necessary Venom for the antidote.

quests.name: Curing the Poison Pt. 2
quests.desc: ：Hello [PLAYERNAME], The Venon is only the first Ingredient we need, I need you to travel south and gather Arachnid Teeth from the Spiders in Phantom Forest.
quests.goals: ：收集 Spiders in Phantom Forest ×30 （Dark Arachnid 1/3、Venomous Arachnid 1/3）

quests.name: Curing the Poison Pt. 3
quests.desc: ：Hello [PLAYERNAME], It would seem the Poison is more advanced than we first suspected. We need to find the source of the paralysis, Could you gather some samples from the Spider Bats located in Phantom Forest?.

quests.name: Curing the Poison Pt. 4
quests.desc: ：Hello [PLAYERNAME], I can't thank you enough for doing this, Please take the ingredients to [FINISHNAME] at the Bichon Town Potion Store.

quests.name: Curing the Poison Pt. 5
quests.desc: ：Hello [PLAYERNAME], I have completed the Antidote, Please deliver it to [FINISHNAME].

quests.name: Curing the Poison Pt. 6
quests.desc: ：Hello [PLAYERNAME], It's time we ended this threat, kill the ArachnidBroodmother responsible for spawning these defiled creatures.

quests.name: Descent into Darkness Pt. 1
quests.desc: ：[PLAYERNAME] please I must speak with you, Strange rumours are emanating from travellers venturing in to the Banya Stone Caves. Talk of the undead rising once again are rife, could you check it out?
quests.goals: ：杀死 Bone Bladesman ×40 （Bone Bladesman 1/1） · 杀死 Bone Soldier ×40 （Bone Soldier 1/1）

quests.name: Descent into Darkness Pt. 2
quests.desc: ：[PLAYERNAME] We must investigate this further, I'm concerned that even fiercer creatures may lurk deeper into the Banya Stone Caves, You must go quickly and find out for me.
quests.goals: ：杀死 Bone Captain ×50 （Bone Captain 1/1） · 杀死 Bone Archer ×30 （Bone Archer 1/1）

quests.name: Descent into Darkness Pt. 3
quests.desc: ：[PLAYERNAME] we have to hit back and hit hard, The entrance to the kings room is guarded by a small army of undead and the generals that control them, please go and slay them.
quests.goals: ：杀死 Bone Monsters ×200 （Bone Captain 1/1、Bone Archer 1/1、Bone Bladesman 1/1、Bone Soldier 1/1、Skeleton Enforcer 1/1） · 杀死 Skeleton Enforcer ×1 （Skeleton Enforcer 1/1）

quests.name: Descent into Darkness Pt. 4
quests.desc: ：[PLAYERNAME] It's time for us to end this, You must travel to the Deepest floor of Banya Stone Cave and destroy Arch Lich Taedu who lives within.
quests.goals: ：杀死 Arch Lich Taedu ×1 （Arch Lich Taedu 1/1）

quests.name: Elephants on Parade
quests.desc: ：Hello [PLAYERNAME], The Evil Elephants in Lost Paradise Forest have been trampling everything. Maybe you could lower their numbers in some way?

quests.name: Feeding Banya Village
quests.desc: ：Hello [PLAYERNAME], Banya Village supplies have been running low recently, could you help us restock our supplies of Edible Chestnuts?

quests.name: Feeding Bichon Town
quests.desc: ：Hello [PLAYERNAME], Bichon Town supplies have been running low recently, could you help us restock our supplies of Edible Chestnuts?

quests.name: Feeding Lost Paradise
quests.desc: ：Hello [PLAYERNAME], Lost Paradise supplies have been running low recently, could you help us restock our supplies of Edible Chestnuts?

quests.name: Gresham's Journal is missing
quests.desc: ：Why hello there [PLAYERNAME]. I appear to have misplaced my journal. I'm fairly sure I saw one of those Claw Cats walking off with it though. Could you find it for me?.

quests.name: Henry's Journal is missing
quests.desc: ：Why hello there [PLAYERNAME]. I appear to have misplaced my journal. I'm fairly sure I saw one of those Claw Cats walking off with it though. Could you find it for me?.

quests.name: Hunting for David's Key
quests.desc: ：Hello [PLAYERNAME], I have a bit of a problem, one of those Scarecrows has gotten hold of the key for the Bichon Town Potion store. Could you get it for me?

quests.name: Hunting for Haylee's Key
quests.desc: ：Hello [PLAYERNAME], I have a bit of a problem, one of those Scarecrows has gotten hold of the key for the Lost Paradise Potion store. Could you get it for me?

quests.name: Hunting for Kacy's Key
quests.desc: ：Hello [PLAYERNAME], I have a bit of a problem, one of those Scarecrows has gotten hold of the key for the Banya Village Potion store. Could you get it for me?

quests.name: Isaac's Journal is missing
quests.desc: ：Why hello there [PLAYERNAME]. I appear to have misplaced my journal. I'm fairly sure I saw one of those Claw Cats walking off with it though. Could you find it for me?.

quests.name: Let's try something new
quests.desc: ：How can I help you today [PLAYERNAME], actually maybe you could me. I've always wanted to try adding some Zombie flesh to my recipes, maybe you can acquire some?
quests.goals: ：收集 Zombies ×50 （GhostSorcerer 1/2、Ghost Mage 1/2、Voracious Ghost 1/2、Devouring Ghost 1/2、Corpse Raising Ghost 1/2、Ghoul Champion 1/1）

quests.name: Reclaiming the Carved Tomb Pt. 1
quests.desc: ：Greetings [PLAYERNAME], It's time for us reclaim the Carved Stone Tomb for ourselves. We need to work our way downwards into the bowels of the tomb and unlock the treasure within, Let's start with the Red and Black Boars that guard the tomb.
quests.goals: ：杀死 Black Boar ×50 （Black Boar 1/1） · 杀死 Red Boar ×50 （Red Boar 1/1）

quests.name: Reclaiming the Carved Tomb Pt. 2
quests.desc: ：That was a great job you did with the Boars[PLAYERNAME], We sent some explorer further into the Tomb and they returned with stories of Serpent like creatures and paralysing moths down there, Can you investigate and eliminate the threat for us?
quests.goals: ：杀死 Claw Serpent ×50 （Claw Serpent 1/1） · 杀死 Wedge Moth ×50 （Wedge Moth 1/1）

quests.name: Reclaiming the Carved Tomb Pt. 3
quests.desc: ：We are closing in on the deepest sections of the Carved Stone Tomb [PLAYERNAME], We've come across a grand entrance that we wish to enter. The room however is closely guarded by 2 TuskLords and creatures that continually overwhelm our explorers with their young, I don't like asking over and over but could you deal with it?
quests.goals: ：杀死 Tusk Lord ×2 （Tusk Lord 1/1） · 杀死 Wedge Moth Larva ×20 （Wedge Moth Larva 1/1）

quests.name: Reclaiming the Carved Tomb Pt. 4
quests.desc: ：[PLAYERNAME] You must save us!, We didn't mean to unleash the creature within the Kings room. I cannot begin to describe the monstrosity ..... Please save us!

quests.name: Time for the Fleas to Flee
quests.desc: ：Over here [PLAYERNAME]!, We could really do with clearing out the Flea Cave north west of here. Mind giving us a hand?
quests.goals: ：杀死 Mutant Flea ×50 （Mutant Flea 1/1） · 杀死 Blaster Mutant Flea ×50 （Blaster Mutant Flea 1/1） · 杀死 Poisonous Mutant Flea ×50 （Poisonous Mutant Flea 1/1） · 杀死 Terror Spike ×1 （Terror Spike 1/1）
quests.zh: Time for the Fleas to Flee

# 22 · 传奇 EI 2.0 资料整理:地图 / 装备 / 技能到哪个阶段

> 调研日期: 2026-08-07
> 目的: 确认《传奇 EI 2.0》(The Evil's Illusion,恶魔的幻影)的地图、装备、技能体系发展到哪个阶段,并对照 Zircon 本地数据库(System.db)所处内容阶段。
> 数据来源: ① 网络资料(详见文末「参考来源」,网页正文/图片已归档至 `docs/research/ei2-research/`);② 本地实测(`Tools/SystemDbProbe` dump `/tmp/zircon-server/Database/`,共 244 地图 / 1078 物品 / 174 魔法 / 309 怪物,副本在 `docs/research/ei2-research/data/`)。

---

## 1. EI 2.0 是什么:身份与历史

| 项 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 全称 | `Legend of Mir II: The Evil's Illusion`(恶魔的幻影),缩写 **EI** |
| 开发商 | 韩国 WEMADE(维美德),《热血传奇》(Mir2)的官方续作 |
| 时间 | 2001 年开发完成,次年在全球公测(盛大代理中文化,2001 年上线) |
| 命运 | 盛大同 WEMADE 因纠纷中断代理,游戏改头换面由**光通代理成为《传奇3》**——所以 EI 2.0 是 Mir2 → Mir3 之间的过渡版本,英文社区(LOMCN)直接把它归入 Mir3 系 |
| 中文圈语境 | 老玩家口中的「传奇 ei2.0」指 2001 年那个版本;LOMCN 确认网上流传的「Mir3 2010 源码」其实就是 EI 2.0 时代的老服务端(C++ 编写、需 VS2010、内容不完整) |

> 来源: ei2.cc 官网项目背景;iamcheyan.com 复刻项目;LOMCN 帖子 `mir3-2010-source-code.100251`。

**结论: EI 2.0 = 传奇3 的前身 / 初代版本。** 讨论「EI 2.0 的内容阶段」等价于讨论「传奇3 内容从哪开始、到哪里」。

---

## 2. 版本演进时间线(内容阶段划分)

| 阶段 | 时间 | 代表内容 | 备注 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **EI 2.0(原生)** | 2001–2002 | 比奇城/比奇矿、盟重、祖玛寺庙、沃玛神殿、赤月山谷、石阁阵、蚂蚁洞穴、**真天宫和黑度宫**、潘夜神殿/石窟、**幽灵船(神舰)**、诺玛遗址、罪孽洞穴、虫峡谷、绝命谷/万年谷、东部石矿、天然洞穴/半兽人洞穴/废矿 | 三职业(战/法/道);画面黑雾;召唤系为骷髅+神兽 |
| **传奇3(光通版)** | 2003 起 | EI 2.0 地图之上续更:龙渊(龙帝/龙后)、冰封圣殿(冰宫)、赤月谷深化、道馆、潘夜岛、北方雪原、失乐园;引入天气效果与第四职业**刺客** | 17173 专区收录的地图全集即此层 |
| **3G / 国际服系** | 2005 前后 | 刺客体系完善(柳叶/幽灵步/召唤傀儡/恶魔降临)、宠物系统(伴随兽)、马系统(马甲)、武器打造/精炼 | 本地库 Companion 系 / HorseArmour / RefineSpecial 属此层 |
| **西沙版本(官方续更)** | 2021(盛大公告 20210623;2024-09 寻龙探宝区实装) | **西部沙漠、西部沙漠地下 1-3、地下城市 1-4、地下矿山 1-3、地下暗阁**,地天灭王 / 暗之地天灭王(每日 2/6/10/14/18/22 点),掉落破山档武器、天赐档防具、三台档饰品;强化技能(潜能点)、阵法系统、沉没的幽灵船副本 | 传奇3 官方最后一次大规模地图更新 |
| **海外/私服原创层** | 各私服自行 | 苏美尔文明系(Enheduanna/Puabi/Urukhia/Zauhk)、Sama(萨玛)系、Odyn 系列装备、遗忘修道院、失落之地 | 官方资料查无「苏美尔版本」,判断为私服/海外服原创 |

> 西沙版本依据: 盛大《传奇3》西沙版本公告页 `actmir3.web.sdo.com/project/banben/20210623`;17173 报道 `mir3.17173.com/content/2024-09-04/20240904181701727.shtml`(寻龙探宝区 2024-09-03 更新、09-08 首杀)。

---

## 3. 地图:网络权威清单 vs 本地 244 张

### 3.1 网络侧:传奇3 官方地图体系(17173 专区)

## 3. 装备差异（MUD3 掉落 vs Zircon）

MUD3 服务端 MonItems（280 个掉落表，明文 GBK）共 **349 件**掉落物品；Zircon 装备表 **1078 件**。按中文名精确/去后缀匹配：

| 归属 | 数量 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| 共享 | 60 | 金币类 + 同名装备 |
| **MUD3 独有** | **289** | Zircon 装备表无对应 |

MUD3 独有样本：七彩金环、井中月、修罗、偃月、六绝星环、乌木剑、乾坤一气、五彩鞋、五彩项链、五行神镜、仙云靴、万年雪霜、体力强效神水（中/大/小/特）等。

> 注意：部分「MUD3 独有」可能是 Zircon 已更名的同名装备（如 井中月→? ），因 Zircon 装备名为英文（术语表中文名覆盖不全）导致未匹配。需要按英文装备名反向核对（见 §5 后续）。

## 4. 技能差异（Zircon 独有刺客）

Zircon 本地库 174 技能按职业分布：战士 32 / 法师 42 / 道士 47 / **刺客 53**。

> **刺客 53 技能为 Zircon 独有**——MUD3/mir3ei 均为三职业（战法道），无刺客职业。Zircon 作为「20 年后」版本新增了整个刺客体系（含刺杀剑术系、毒系、潜行系等）。
